'''Kuda's Compound''' was a large garage and vehicle dealership that specialized in modifying and repairing swoops on the planet [[Stend VI]]. It was owned by the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] businessman [[Kaylo NaKuda]]. Kaylo would often incorporate [[Vector Technologies]], owned by his friend [[Yin Vocta]], into his repairs.
